## Checklist

- [ ] I have run `pytest` locally and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `ruff check src/` and `ruff format --check src/` with no issues.
- [ ] I have added or updated localization strings (`.ftl`) instead of hardcoded text.
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` with a concise description of the change.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests that cover the new behavior.
- [ ] I have verified the change does not introduce new broad `except Exception` blocks without justification.
- [ ] I have updated documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, or inline docstrings) if the change affects user-facing behavior.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactor / performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation only
